title: JUBILEE: benchmark environment and reproduction materials for off-policy evaluation in debt collections
description: Simulator of a relational loan-month collections world with known generating process, hidden confounders and a randomized exploration floor; an off-policy-evaluation estimator panel; result records and scripts that rebuild the tables, figures and quoted numbers of the JUBILEE paper (JUBILEE: A Benchmark Environment for Off-Policy Evaluation in Debt Collections). Simulator model 2.1.0 (full settlement), the protocols and result records of the reruns behind the paper (parameter grid, paired study under the synthetic score and simulated cash, annotated direct method) and a snapshot of model 2.0.0. The large cohort extracts are deposited separately.
